scripts.db:migrate:production-snapshot: wrangler d1 migrations apply tempo-production --local --env production --persist-to .wrangler/production-snapshot
scripts.dev:production-snapshot: npm run db:pull:production && npm run db:migrate:production-snapshot && npm run build:client && wrangler dev --env production --local --persist-to .wrangler/production-snapshot
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply tempo-production --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:client && wrangler deploy --env production
